summary: Read a binary search tree holding between 2 and 100 nodes. Each node stores an integer from 0 through 100000. Select any two different nodes and compute the absolute gap between the integers they store. Among every such selection, find the smallest gap and write it.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
